version.changelog: Initial release: AI-powered weekly report generator

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only weekly-report text formatter that only needs the user's input and doesn't request credentials, installs, or unusual system access—its declared behavior matches its requirements.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and SKILL.md all describe transforming user bullet points into polished weekly reports. The skill declares no binaries, env vars, config paths, or installs — which is proportionate for a text-formatting/writing assistant.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only prompt-style instructions and example input/output for producing reports. It does not instruct the agent to read files, access environment variables, call external endpoints, or exfiltrate data beyond the normal model invocation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present; this is instruction-only which minimizes disk writes and installation risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Nothing in the SKILL.md implies extra secrets are needed.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not 'always: true' and is user-invocable. disable-model-invocation is false (normal), meaning the agent could invoke it autonomously — acceptable here given the skill's limited scope, but users should be aware the model may call it without explicit every-time permission.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it only transforms text into a polished weekly report and asks for no credentials or installs. Before using, avoid pasting sensitive or proprietary information into the prompt (your input will be processed by the model and may be logged depending on the platform). Also verify where the model runs (local vs. cloud) if you have privacy concerns. If you want stricter control, only invoke the skill manually and avoid enabling autonomous calls.
